items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Ron? No, I didn't think he did. No, never did make them.

ctx.x: Would Buddy make elevens, did he tell me about that? Yeah.
Elevens and thirteens. No, no, no. He said, did Buddy used to make elevens and thirteens? Ron? No, I didn't think he did. No, never did make them.
